# NFL Week 10 - Sun Nov 15 / Mon Nov 16

Edge factor applied (~0.6). Covers AI (Kalshi lines), Dimers, SportsLine where published.

## Pick
- **Texans -4.5 at Browns (-110), 0.5u (1 PM).** SportsLine's model backs Houston to cover in well over 50% of sims; Covers AI HOU 24-17; ESPN matchup predictor 76.6%; Dimers 65.9% and Squawka's model (-5) sit on the number. Cleveland allows a league-worst 3.82 sacks a game (Watson sacked 33 times in eight games) and Houston had eight sacks last week - the weak-line dog fade that won with Rams -6.5. Risks: Will Anderson Jr. questionable (ankle); 92% of money already on Houston; an SBR capper takes Cleveland. Only at -4.5 (some books -5.5).

## Leans
1. Bills -7 at Jets - SportsLine double-digit win, Covers AI 30-20, Dimers 75.1%. At -7.5/-8.5 it is the hook through 7; bet only at -7.
2. Dolphins +3.5 at Colts - 80% of money on 30% of tickets and the line fell from 6.5, but Kyle McCord makes his first start (backup-QB dog). Pass.
3. Rams/Cardinals Under 40.5 - Nacua and Adams out, Carson Beck's first start for Arizona; total already fell 7 points (below the opener). Pass.
4. Cardinals +9.5 - Covers AI LAR by 7, 72% of money on Arizona; rookie QB debut. Pass.

## Passes
Lions -2.5 (Munich): SportsLine DET 68%, Dimers on the number, Covers AI NE +2.5 - split. Chiefs -3.5, Bengals -3.5: hook through 3. Seahawks/Raiders: Lock vs Mendoza's first start, lines differ by book. 49ers -4.5, Packers -3, Saints, Jaguars -10.5: models on the number. MNF Chargers at Ravens (Brissett for Baltimore): Covers AI BAL by 3, Dimers ~4.5 - revisit Monday.
NCAAF Sunday: Ole Miss at Oklahoma (1 PM) - Covers AI Ole Miss 24-23, SportsLine likes Ole Miss; near pick'em, no price edge found. Pass.
